messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- In the year of the Lord, one thousand nine hundred and forty, a voice did speak from the heavens, and the nations of the earth did tremble with fear.
- Two great wars did consume the lands, and the blood of men ran like a river through each valley of the world.
- From the ashes of the old world, a new order did arise, yet the powers of the earth were shaken unto their foundations.
- Yet a cold war did spread across the world, and the peoples of the east and west did stand in fearful silence, watching one another with eyes full of dread.
- In the final decade of that century, a great empire did fall, and the walls that stood for decades were reduced to dust.
- And lo, the people of the earth did look upon the stars, and they walked upon the moon as though it were a common path.
- Thus did the century of fire and steel come to a close, and the nations did look forward to a dawn that had not yet arrived.
